title: ApproxBrain: Certified Sufficiency Frontiers in Connectome-Constrained Neural Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.06929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background. A connectome specifies the substrate available to a nervous system, not how much of it a given computation requires. Reported compact sufficient circuits are point estimates: one subset, one task, one fidelity threshold, one parameterisation. Methods. We formalise computational sufficiency as a cost-indexed family of neuron subsets conditioned on a task and a tolerance pair (permitted degradation epsilon, permitted failure fraction rho), separate task adequacy from phenotype fidelity, and certify candidates on held-out parameter draws with one-sided bounds rather than reporting a single minimum. We measure three quantities a single circuit cannot express: non-decomposability, degeneracy, and an intervention-derived role taxonomy. Results. On a released walking simulator, the published 148-neuron circuit is certified sufficient with margin (mean Dtask = 0.017 over 32 held-out draws, no failure), no 146- or 147-neuron subset

translated_title: ApproxBrain：连接组约束神经系统中经认证的充分性前沿
translated_abstract: 背景。连接组规定了神经系统可用的物质基础，而非某项给定计算需要用到其中多少。已报道的紧凑充分回路都只是点估计：单个子集、单个任务、单个保真度阈值、单次参数化。方法。我们将计算充分性形式化为以代价为索引的神经元子集族，该族以任务和一对容差参数（允许的性能退化 ε 与允许的失败比例 ρ）为条件；我们将任务充分性与表型保真度区分开来，并在留出的参数采样上以单侧界对候选回路进行认证，而非报告单一的极小回路。我们测量三个单一回路无法表达的量：不可分解性、退化性，以及一种基于干预推导的功能角色分类。结果。在一个公开发布的行走模拟器上，已发表的148神经元回路被认证为带有余量的充分回路（在32个留出参数采样上平均 Dtask = 0.017，无失败），而不存在任何146或147神经元的子集……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ApproxBrain框架，将神经回路的“计算充分性”从单一最小回路的点估计扩展为经统计认证、随代价变化的充分性前沿，并据此量化回路的不可分解性、退化性与功能角色分工。
en_tdlr: ApproxBrain transforms minimal-circuit identification from single point estimates into statistically certified, cost-indexed sufficiency frontiers that quantify non-decomposability, degeneracy, and functional roles in connectome-constrained neural systems.
